block.rs_create_compat.separation_frame..zh: 右键线缆/流体管道即套住那一格（该格不再与邻居连接）；潜行右键取下。
block.rs_create_compat.separation_frame..en: Right-click a cable or fluid pipe to sheath that cell (it stops connecting to its neighbours); sneak + right-click to take it off.

block.rs_create_compat.infinite_separati.zh: 同分隔框架，但套上不消耗、取下不回收，外壳带附魔光泽。
block.rs_create_compat.infinite_separati.en: Same as the Separation Frame, but it is never consumed and cannot be recovered, and its shell glints.

block.rs_create_compat.camouflage_frame..zh: 伪装框架只能装在管道或线缆上
block.rs_create_compat.camouflage_frame..en: (hint) The Camouflage Frame can only go on a pipe or cable

message.rs_create_compat.frame_need_pipe.zh: 只能套在线缆或流体管道上
message.rs_create_compat.frame_need_pipe.en: (hint) Only cables and fluid pipes can be framed

message.rs_create_compat.frame_sheathed.zh: 已套上分隔框架：这一格不再与邻居连接
message.rs_create_compat.frame_sheathed.en: Frame applied: this cell no longer connects to its neighbours

message.rs_create_compat.frame_remove_hi.zh: 这一格已套住；潜行右键可取回框架
message.rs_create_compat.frame_remove_hi.en: Already framed - sneak + right-click to take the frame back

message.rs_create_compat.frame_unsheathe.zh: 已取下分隔框架：连接已恢复
